topic: A tiny immediate-mode UI library in ANSI C that rebuilds controls every frame in fixed memory
audience: a developer new to immediate-mode UI who has never built a GUI toolkit
analogy: a cafe chalkboard menu that is erased and rewritten from scratch on every customer visit
why: A story following one frame from input to draw commands fits because the UI is recreated every frame, and overview depth fits a tiny 1100-line tool.
